70			return func(*Store) {}
71		}
72		return WithDiagnosticSink(func(diagnostic Diagnostic) {
73			fmt.Fprintln(writer, diagnostic.Error())
74		})
75	}
76	
77	// Store is a directory of one TOML file per asset.
78	type Store struct {
79		Dir string
80	
81		mu          sync.Mutex
82		generateID  IDGenerator
83		clock       func() time.Time
84		diagnostics DiagnosticSink
85	}
86	
87	// NewStore returns a catalog rooted at dir.
88	func NewStore(dir string, options ...StoreOption) *Store {
89		store := &Store{
90			Dir:        dir,
91			generateID: uuid.NewString,
92			clock:      time.Now,
93		}
94		for _, option := range options {
95			if option != nil {
96				option(store)
97			}
98		}
99		return store
100	}
101	
102	// WithLock runs operation while holding the catalog's cross-process advisory
103	// lock. It is intended for short read-match-write transactions; expensive
104	// discovery belongs before the lock. The operating system releases the lock if
105	// the process exits unexpectedly.
106	func (s *Store) WithLock(ctx context.Context, operation func() error) (err error) {
107		if s == nil {
108			return errors.New("lock nil catalog store")
109		}
110		if operation == nil {
111			return errors.New("catalog lock requires an operation")
112		}
113		if ctx == nil {
114			ctx = context.Background()
115		}
116		if err := os.MkdirAll(s.Dir, 0o755); err != nil {
117			return fmt.Errorf("create catalog directory for lock: %w", err)
118		}
119		absoluteDir, err := filepath.Abs(s.Dir)
120		if err != nil {
121			return fmt.Errorf("make catalog directory absolute for lock: %w", err)
122		}
123		canonicalDir, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(absoluteDir)
124		if err != nil {
125			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize catalog directory for lock: %w", err)
126		}
127		lockPath := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(canonicalDir), "."+filepath.Base(canonicalDir)+".lock")
128		lock, err := acquireCatalogFileLock(ctx, lockPath)
129		if err != nil {
130			return fmt.Errorf("acquire catalog lock: %w", err)
131		}
132		defer func() {
133			if releaseErr := lock.Close(); releaseErr != nil {
134				err = errors.Join(err, fmt.Errorf("release catalog lock: %w", releaseErr))
135			}
136		}()
137		return operation()
138	}
139	
140	func (s *Store) path(id string) string { return filepath.Join(s.Dir, id+".toml") }
141	
142	// Create assigns a random stable ID and atomically persists entry. The caller's
143	// value is updated only after the rename succeeds.
144	func (s *Store) Create(entry *Entry) error {
145		if entry == nil {
146			return errors.New("create nil catalog entry")
147		}
148		if entry.ID != "" {
149			return fmt.Errorf("create catalog asset: ID is assigned by the store")
150		}
151	
152		s.mu.Lock()
153		defer s.mu.Unlock()
154	
155		for range 32 {
156			candidate := entry.Clone()
157			candidate.ID = s.nextID()
158			if err := ValidateID(candidate.ID); err != nil {
159				return fmt.Errorf("generated catalog ID: %w", err)
160			}
161	
162			now := s.now()
163			candidate.SchemaVersion = CurrentSchemaVersion
164			if candidate.Created.IsZero() {
165				candidate.Created = now
166			}
167			if candidate.Discovered.IsZero() {
168				candidate.Discovered = now
169			}
170			candidate.Updated = now
171			prepareNewNested(candidate, now)
172			candidate.Normalize()
173			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
174				return err
175			}
176			if err := os.MkdirAll(s.Dir, 0o755); err != nil {
177				return fmt.Errorf("create catalog directory: %w", err)
178			}
179			if _, err := os.Lstat(s.path(candidate.ID)); err == nil {
180				continue
181			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
182				return fmt.Errorf("check catalog ID %s: %w", candidate.ID, err)
183			}
184			if err := s.writeAtomic(candidate); err != nil {
185				return err
186			}
187			*entry = *candidate
188			return nil
189		}
190		return fmt.Errorf("generate unique catalog ID: %w", ErrAlreadyExists)
191	}
192	
193	// Get loads one asset by exact ID.
194	func (s *Store) Get(id string) (*Entry, error) {
195		if err := ValidateID(id); err != nil {
196			return nil, err
197		}
198		return s.get(id)
199	}
200	
201	func (s *Store) get(id string) (*Entry, error) {
202		data, err := os.ReadFile(s.path(id))
203		if err != nil {
204			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
205				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
206			}
207			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read catalog asset %s: %w", id, err)
208		}
209		var header struct {
210			SchemaVersion int `toml:"schema_version"`
211		}
212		if _, err := toml.Decode(string(data), &header); err != nil {
213			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode catalog asset %s schema: %w", id, err)
214		}
215		if header.SchemaVersion != 0 && header.SchemaVersion != CurrentSchemaVersion {
216			return nil, &UnsupportedSchemaError{ID: id, Version: header.SchemaVersion}
217		}
218	
219		var entry Entry
220		metadata, err := toml.Decode(string(data), &entry)
221		if err != nil {
222			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode catalog asset %s: %w", id, err)
223		}
224		if undecoded := metadata.Undecoded(); len(undecoded) > 0 {
225			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode catalog asset %s: unknown field(s): %v", id, undecoded)
226		}
227		entry.ID = id
228		// Version zero is the only implicit form: it means the schema marker was
229		// absent, not that an unknown future layout should be guessed.
230		if entry.SchemaVersion == 0 {
231			entry.SchemaVersion = CurrentSchemaVersion
232		}
233		entry.Normalize()
234		if err := entry.Validate(); err != nil {
235			return nil, fmt.Errorf("validate catalog asset %s: %w", id, err)
236		}
237		return &entry, nil
238	}
239	
240	// List loads every valid record in deterministic ID order. Per-record failures
241	// are skipped and sent to the configured diagnostic sink; directory-level
242	// failures are returned.
243	func (s *Store) List() ([]*Entry, error) {
244		entries, diagnostics, err := s.ListWithDiagnostics()
245		if err != nil {
246			return nil, err
247		}
248		s.reportDiagnostics(diagnostics)
249		return entries, nil
250	}
251	
252	func (s *Store) reportDiagnostics(diagnostics []Diagnostic) {
253		if s.diagnostics == nil {
254			return
255		}
256		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
257			s.diagnostics(diagnostic)
258		}
259	}
260	
261	// ListWithDiagnostics is List's explicit diagnostic form. It is useful to
262	// services that want to aggregate notices rather than render them immediately.
263	func (s *Store) ListWithDiagnostics() ([]*Entry, []Diagnostic, error) {
264		directoryEntries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)
265		if err != nil {
266			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
267				return nil, nil, nil
268			}
269			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("read catalog directory: %w", err)
270		}
271	
272		var entries []*Entry
273		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
274		for _, directoryEntry := range directoryEntries {
275			name := directoryEntry.Name()
276			if directoryEntry.IsDir() || strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".toml") {
277				continue
278			}
279			id := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".toml")
280			entry, err := s.Get(id)
281			if err != nil {
282				diagnostics = append(diagnostics, Diagnostic{Path: filepath.Join(s.Dir, name), Err: err})
283				continue
284			}
285			entries = append(entries, entry)
286		}
287		Sort(entries)
288		sort.Slice(diagnostics, func(i, j int) bool { return diagnostics[i].Path < diagnostics[j].Path })
289		return entries, diagnostics, nil
290	}
291	
292	// Update applies mutate to a deep copy and atomically replaces the record only
293	// if the mutation and validation both succeed. ID, Created, and Discovered are
294	// immutable.
295	func (s *Store) Update(id string, mutate func(*Entry) error) (*Entry, error) {
296		if err := ValidateID(id); err != nil {
297			return nil, err
298		}
299		if mutate == nil {
300			return nil, errors.New("catalog update requires a mutation")
301		}
302	
303		s.mu.Lock()
304		defer s.mu.Unlock()
305	
306		current, err := s.get(id)
307		if err != nil {
308			return nil, err
309		}
310		updated := current.Clone()
311		if err := mutate(updated); err != nil {
312			return nil, err
313		}
314		if updated.ID != current.ID {
315			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change ID")
316		}
317		if updated.SchemaVersion != current.SchemaVersion {
318			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change schema version")
319		}
320		if !updated.Created.Equal(current.Created) {
321			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change Created")
322		}
323		if !updated.Discovered.Equal(current.Discovered) {
324			return nil, errors.New("catalog update cannot change Discovered")
325		}
326	
327		now := s.now()
328		updated.Updated = now
329		prepareUpdatedNested(current, updated, now)
330		stampChangedLocations(current, updated, now)
331		updated.Normalize()
332		if err := updated.Validate(); err != nil {
333			return nil, err
334		}
335		if err := s.writeAtomic(updated); err != nil {
336			return nil, err
337		}
338		return updated.Clone(), nil
339	}
340	
341	// Sort orders entries by stable ID.
342	func Sort(entries []*Entry) {
343		sort.SliceStable(entries, func(i, j int) bool {
344			return entries[i].ID < entries[j].ID
345		})
346	}
347	
348	func (s *Store) writeAtomic(entry *Entry) error {
349		temporary, err := os.CreateTemp(s.Dir, "."+entry.ID+".*.tmp")
350		if err != nil {
351			return fmt.Errorf("create catalog temp file: %w", err)
352		}
353		name := temporary.Name()
354		defer os.Remove(name)
355	
356		if err := toml.NewEncoder(temporary).Encode(entry); err != nil {
357			_ = temporary.Close()
358			return fmt.Errorf("encode catalog asset %s: %w", entry.ID, err)
359		}
360		if err := temporary.Close(); err != nil {
361			return fmt.Errorf("close catalog temp file: %w", err)
362		}
363		if err := os.Chmod(name, 0o644); err != nil {
364			return fmt.Errorf("set catalog file mode: %w", err)
365		}
366		if err := os.Rename(name, s.path(entry.ID)); err != nil {
367			return fmt.Errorf("replace catalog asset %s: %w", entry.ID, err)
368		}
369		return nil
370	}
371	
372	func (s *Store) nextID() string {
373		if s.generateID == nil {
374			return uuid.NewString()
375		}
376		return s.generateID()
377	}
378	
379	func (s *Store) now() time.Time {
380		if s.clock == nil {
381			return time.Now().UTC()
382		}
383		return s.clock().UTC()
384	}
385	
386	func prepareNewNested(entry *Entry, now time.Time) {
387		if entry.Experiment != nil {
388			if entry.Experiment.Phase == "" {
389				entry.Experiment.Phase = PhaseActive
390			}
391			if entry.Experiment.Started.IsZero() {
392				entry.Experiment.Started = now
393			}
394		}
395		for host, location := range entry.Locations {
396			if location.Updated.IsZero() {
397				location.Updated = now
398				entry.Locations[host] = location
399			}
400		}
401		if entry.RecoveryReceipt != nil && entry.RecoveryReceipt.Created.IsZero() {
402			entry.RecoveryReceipt.Created = now
403		}
404		if entry.MoveIntent != nil && entry.MoveIntent.Started.IsZero() {
405			entry.MoveIntent.Started = now
406		}
407	}
408	
409	func prepareUpdatedNested(current, updated *Entry, now time.Time) {
410		if current.Experiment == nil && updated.Experiment != nil {
411			if updated.Experiment.Phase == "" {
412				updated.Experiment.Phase = PhaseActive
413			}
414			if updated.Experiment.Started.IsZero() {
415				updated.Experiment.Started = now
416			}
417		}
418		if updated.RecoveryReceipt != nil && updated.RecoveryReceipt.Created.IsZero() &&
419			(current.RecoveryReceipt == nil || recoveryPayloadChanged(*current.RecoveryReceipt, *updated.RecoveryReceipt)) {
420			updated.RecoveryReceipt.Created = now
421		}
422		if updated.MoveIntent != nil && updated.MoveIntent.Started.IsZero() &&
423			(current.MoveIntent == nil || moveIntentPayloadChanged(*current.MoveIntent, *updated.MoveIntent)) {
424			updated.MoveIntent.Started = now
425		}
426	}
427	
428	func recoveryPayloadChanged(left, right RecoveryReceipt) bool {
429		left.Created = time.Time{}
430		right.Created = time.Time{}
431		return left != right
432	}
433	
434	func moveIntentPayloadChanged(left, right MoveIntent) bool {
435		left.Started = time.Time{}
436		right.Started = time.Time{}
437		return left != right
438	}
439	
440	func stampChangedLocations(current, updated *Entry, now time.Time) {
441		for host, location := range updated.Locations {
442			previous, existed := current.Locations[host]
443			if !existed || locationPayloadChanged(previous, location) {
444				location.Updated = now
445			} else {
446				// Updated is store-owned metadata. A mutation that did not change this
447				// host's location must not make it look newly observed.
448				location.Updated = previous.Updated
449			}
450			updated.Locations[host] = location
451		}
452	}
453	
454	func locationPayloadChanged(left, right Location) bool {
455		left.Updated = time.Time{}
456		right.Updated = time.Time{}
457		return left != right
458	}

22	// AmbiguousMatchError reports records that cannot be safely distinguished. A
23	// remote-only ambiguity is never resolved by picking the first entry.
24	type AmbiguousMatchError struct {
25		Observation  Observation
26		CandidateIDs []string
27		Reason       string
28	}
29	
30	func (e *AmbiguousMatchError) Error() string {
31		reason := e.Reason
32		if reason == "" {
33			reason = "multiple records match"
34		}
35		return fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s (%s)", ErrAmbiguous, reason, strings.Join(e.CandidateIDs, ", "))
36	}

38	func (e *AmbiguousMatchError) Unwrap() error { return ErrAmbiguous }

40	// Observation is live repository identity gathered from discovery. Path is the
41	// navigation path, RealPath its physical target, and either common-dir field may
42	// carry Git's shared administrative directory. CommonDir matches repo.Repo;
43	// GitCommonDir is accepted for callers using gitx.Repo terminology.
44	type Observation struct {
45		Host           string
46		Path           string
47		RealPath       string
48		CommonDir      string
49		GitCommonDir   string
50		Name           string
51		RemoteIdentity string
52	}

54	// Registry adds live matching and lazy repository persistence to a Store.
55	type Registry struct {

58	}

60	// NewRegistry returns a registry backed by store.

98	// Match finds an observation without changing the catalog. Exact canonical path
99	// or common-directory identity on the same host always wins. A remote identity
100	// is considered only as a conservative relocation hint.
101	func (r *Registry) Match(observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
102		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(observation, false)
103		if err != nil {
104			return nil, err
105		}
106		entry, _, err := r.match(normalized)
107		return entry, err

110	// EnsureRepository returns the matching repository, attaching the observed host
111	// location when safe. If nothing matches—or a remote is ambiguous because it
112	// may describe another live clone—it creates a distinct repository record.
113	func (r *Registry) EnsureRepository(observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
114		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(observation, true)
115		if err != nil {
116			return nil, err
117		}
118		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
119			return nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
120		}
121	
122		r.mu.Lock()
123		defer r.mu.Unlock()
124	
125		matched, method, matchErr := r.match(normalized)
126		if matchErr == nil {
127			return r.attach(matched.ID, normalized)
128		}
129		if !errors.Is(matchErr, ErrNotFound) && !(errors.Is(matchErr, ErrAmbiguous) && method == matchRemote) {
130			return nil, matchErr
131		}
132	
133		entry := &Entry{
134			Kind:           KindRepository,
135			Name:           normalized.Name,
136			RemoteIdentity: normalized.RemoteIdentity,
137			Locations: map[string]Location{
138				normalized.Host: locationFromObservation(normalized),
139			},
140		}
141		if err := r.store.Create(entry); err != nil {
142			return nil, err
143		}
144		return entry.Clone(), nil
145	}

152	// Attach explicitly records observation as id's present location. Explicit
153	// attachment may update a changed remote because the caller supplied the stable
154	// catalog identity rather than asking the remote hint to choose one.

156		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(observation, true)

158			return nil, err
159		}

168	func (r *Registry) attach(id string, observation Observation) (*Entry, error) {
169		return r.store.Update(id, func(entry *Entry) error {
170			if observation.RemoteIdentity != "" {
171				entry.RemoteIdentity = observation.RemoteIdentity
172			}
173			location := locationFromObservation(observation)
174			if previous, ok := entry.LocationFor(observation.Host); ok && location.GitCommonDir == "" &&
175				intersects(canonicalValues(observation.Path, observation.RealPath),
176					canonicalValues(previous.CurrentPath, previous.RestorePath, previous.RealPath)) {
177				location.GitCommonDir = previous.GitCommonDir
178			}
179			return entry.SetLocation(observation.Host, location)
180		})
181	}

184	// back to a remote identity.

186		normalized, err := normalizeObservation(Observation{Host: host, Path: path}, false)
187		if err != nil {

191		if err != nil {

195		if len(matches) == 0 && len(diagnostics) > 0 {
196			return nil, incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics)
197		}
198		if len(matches) > 0 {

201		return selectExact(normalized, matches)
202	}

224	type matchMethod int
225	
226	const (
227		matchNone matchMethod = iota
228		matchExact
229		matchRemote
230	)
231	
232	func (r *Registry) match(observation Observation) (*Entry, matchMethod, error) {
233		entries, diagnostics, err := r.entriesWithDiagnostics()
234		if err != nil {
235			return nil, matchNone, err
236		}
237		if matches := exactMatches(entries, observation); len(matches) > 0 {
238			r.store.reportDiagnostics(diagnostics)
239			entry, err := selectExact(observation, matches)
240			return entry, matchExact, err
241		}
242		if len(diagnostics) > 0 {
243			return nil, matchNone, incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics)
244		}
245		if observation.RemoteIdentity == "" {
246			return nil, matchNone, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation %q: %w", observation.Path, ErrNotFound)
247		}
248	
249		var remoteMatches []*Entry
250		for _, entry := range entries {
251			if NormalizeRemoteIdentity(entry.RemoteIdentity) == observation.RemoteIdentity {
252				remoteMatches = append(remoteMatches, entry)
253			}
254		}
255		Sort(remoteMatches)
256		switch len(remoteMatches) {
257		case 0:
258			return nil, matchNone, fmt.Errorf("remote %q: %w", observation.RemoteIdentity, ErrNotFound)
259		case 1:
260			if remoteCanRelocate(remoteMatches[0], observation) {
261				return remoteMatches[0], matchRemote, nil
262			}
263			return nil, matchRemote, ambiguous(observation, remoteMatches,
264				"remote also belongs to a different live clone on this host")
265		default:
266			return nil, matchRemote, ambiguous(observation, remoteMatches,
267				"remote identity matches multiple catalog records")
268		}
269	}

271	func (r *Registry) entriesWithDiagnostics() ([]*Entry, []Diagnostic, error) {
272		if r == nil || r.store == nil {
273			return nil, nil, errors.New("catalog registry has no store")
274		}
275		return r.store.ListWithDiagnostics()
276	}

278	func incompleteCatalogError(diagnostics []Diagnostic) error {
279		errorsToJoin := make([]error, 1, len(diagnostics)+1)
280		errorsToJoin[0] = ErrIncompleteCatalog
281		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
282			errorsToJoin = append(errorsToJoin, diagnostic)
283		}
284		return errors.Join(errorsToJoin...)
285	}

287	func exactMatches(entries []*Entry, observation Observation) []*Entry {
288		matched := make(map[string]*Entry)
289		observationPaths := canonicalValues(observation.Path, observation.RealPath)
290		observationCommon := canonicalValue(observation.CommonDir)
291		for _, entry := range entries {
292			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(observation.Host)
293			if !ok {
294				continue
295			}
296			locationPaths := canonicalValues(location.CurrentPath, location.RestorePath, location.RealPath)
297			pathMatch := intersects(observationPaths, locationPaths)
298			commonMatch := observationCommon != "" && observationCommon == canonicalValue(location.GitCommonDir)
299			if pathMatch || commonMatch {
300				matched[entry.ID] = entry
301			}
302		}
303		out := make([]*Entry, 0, len(matched))
304		for _, entry := range matched {
305			out = append(out, entry)
306		}
307		Sort(out)
308		return out
309	}
310	
311	func selectExact(observation Observation, matches []*Entry) (*Entry, error) {
312		switch len(matches) {
313		case 0:
314			return nil, fmt.Errorf("catalog path %q on host %q: %w", observation.Path, observation.Host, ErrNotFound)
315		case 1:
316			return matches[0], nil
317		default:
318			return nil, ambiguous(observation, matches, "canonical path or Git common directory matches multiple records")
319		}
320	}
321	
322	func ambiguous(observation Observation, entries []*Entry, reason string) error {
323		ids := make([]string, len(entries))
324		for i, entry := range entries {
325			ids[i] = entry.ID
326		}
327		sort.Strings(ids)
328		return &AmbiguousMatchError{Observation: observation, CandidateIDs: ids, Reason: reason}
329	}
330	
331	func remoteCanRelocate(entry *Entry, observation Observation) bool {
332		location, ok := entry.LocationFor(observation.Host)
333		if !ok {
334			return true
335		}
336		// Exact aliases, restore paths, and common directories were already handled.
337		// A navigation symlink may disappear while its physical clone or Git common
338		// directory remains, so every stored identity path must be absent before the
339		// remote can be treated as relocation evidence. Archives also deliberately
340		// block relocation while their bytes remain.
341		for _, path := range []string{
342			location.CurrentPath,
343			location.RestorePath,
344			location.RealPath,
345			location.GitCommonDir,
346		} {
347			if path == "" {
348				continue
349			}
350			if pathMayStillExist(path) {
351				return false
352			}
353		}
354		return true
355	}
356	
357	func pathMayStillExist(path string) bool {
358		if _, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil || !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
359			// Lstat deliberately counts a dangling symlink as existing evidence.
360			return true
361		}
362		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path)
363		if err != nil {
364			return true
365		}
366		_, err = os.Stat(canonical)
367		return err == nil || !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist)
368	}
369	
370	func locationFromObservation(observation Observation) Location {
371		currentPath := observation.Path
372		if currentPath == "" {
373			currentPath = observation.RealPath
374		}
375		return Location{
376			State:        LocationPresent,
377			CurrentPath:  currentPath,
378			RealPath:     observation.RealPath,
379			GitCommonDir: observation.CommonDir,
380		}
381	}
382	
383	func normalizeObservation(observation Observation, requireLocation bool) (Observation, error) {
384		observation.Host = strings.TrimSpace(observation.Host)
385		observation.Name = strings.TrimSpace(observation.Name)
386		if observation.Host == "" {
387			return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog observation host is required")
388		}
389	
390		commonDir := observation.CommonDir
391		if commonDir == "" {
392			commonDir = observation.GitCommonDir
393		} else if observation.GitCommonDir != "" {
394			left, leftErr := pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
395			right, rightErr := pathx.Canonical(observation.GitCommonDir)
396			if leftErr != nil || rightErr != nil || left != right {
397				return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog observation CommonDir and GitCommonDir disagree")
398			}
399		}
400	
401		var err error
402		canonicalPath := ""
403		if observation.Path != "" {
404			observation.Path, err = absoluteClean(observation.Path)
405			if err != nil {
406				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation path: %w", err)
407			}
408			canonicalPath, err = pathx.Canonical(observation.Path)
409			if err != nil {
410				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation path: %w", err)
411			}
412		}
413		if observation.RealPath != "" {
414			observation.RealPath, err = pathx.Canonical(observation.RealPath)
415			if err != nil {
416				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation real path: %w", err)
417			}
418			if canonicalPath != "" && canonicalPath != observation.RealPath {
419				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation Path and RealPath disagree: %q != %q",
420					canonicalPath, observation.RealPath)
421			}
422		} else {
423			observation.RealPath = canonicalPath
424		}
425		if commonDir != "" {
426			observation.CommonDir, err = pathx.Canonical(commonDir)
427			if err != nil {
428				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog observation Git common directory: %w", err)
429			}
430		}
431		observation.GitCommonDir = observation.CommonDir
432		observation.RemoteIdentity = NormalizeRemoteIdentity(observation.RemoteIdentity)
433	
434		if requireLocation && observation.Path == "" && observation.RealPath == "" {
435			return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog repository observation requires a path")
436		}
437		if requireLocation {
438			path := observation.Path
439			if path == "" {
440				path = observation.RealPath
441			}
442			info, statErr := os.Stat(path)
443			if statErr != nil {
444				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog repository observation path %q: %w", path, statErr)
445			}
446			if !info.IsDir() {
447				return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog repository observation path %q is not a directory", path)
448			}
449			if observation.CommonDir != "" {
450				commonInfo, commonErr := os.Stat(observation.CommonDir)
451				if commonErr != nil {
452					return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog repository observation Git common directory %q: %w",
453						observation.CommonDir, commonErr)
454				}
455				if !commonInfo.IsDir() {
456					return Observation{}, fmt.Errorf("catalog repository observation Git common directory %q is not a directory",
457						observation.CommonDir)
458				}
459			}
460		}
461		if observation.Name == "" {
462			path := observation.Path
463			if path == "" {
464				path = observation.RealPath
465			}
466			if path != "" {
467				observation.Name = filepath.Base(path)
468			}
469		}
470		if requireLocation && (observation.Name == "" || observation.Name == ".") {
471			return Observation{}, errors.New("catalog repository observation requires a name")
472		}
473		return observation, nil
474	}
475	
476	func absoluteClean(path string) (string, error) {
477		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
478		if err != nil {
479			return "", err
480		}
481		return filepath.Clean(absolute), nil
482	}
483	
484	func canonicalValues(values ...string) map[string]struct{} {
485		out := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
486		for _, value := range values {
487			if canonical := canonicalValue(value); canonical != "" {
488				out[canonical] = struct{}{}
489			}
490		}
491		return out
492	}
493	
494	func canonicalValue(value string) string {
495		if value == "" {
496			return ""
497		}
498		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(value)
499		if err != nil {
500			return ""
501		}
502		return canonical
503	}
504	
505	func intersects(left, right map[string]struct{}) bool {
506		for value := range left {
507			if _, ok := right[value]; ok {
508				return true
509			}
510		}
511		return false
512	}
513	
514	// NormalizeRemoteIdentity converts common HTTPS and SCP-style Git URLs into a
515	// stable host/path key. Hosts are case-insensitive, but paths are preserved
516	// because arbitrary Git servers may use a case-sensitive repository namespace.
517	// The result remains only a hint for matching.
518	func NormalizeRemoteIdentity(identity string) string {
519		identity = strings.TrimSpace(identity)
520		if identity == "" {
521			return ""
522		}
523		if parsed, err := url.Parse(identity); err == nil && parsed.Scheme != "" {
524			if strings.EqualFold(parsed.Scheme, "file") {
525				return ""
526			}
527			if parsed.Host != "" {
528				return remoteIdentityKey(parsed.Host, parsed.EscapedPath())
529			}
530		}
531		if looksLikeLocalRemote(identity) {
532			return ""
533		}
534	
535		afterUser := identity
536		user := ""
537		if at := strings.LastIndexByte(afterUser, '@'); at >= 0 {
538			user, afterUser = afterUser[:at], afterUser[at+1:]
539		}
540		if host, remotePath, ok := splitSCPLike(afterUser); ok {
541			if user != "" && !strings.EqualFold(user, "git") && !strings.HasPrefix(remotePath, "/") {
542				remotePath = "~" + user + "/" + remotePath
543			}
544			return remoteIdentityKey(host, remotePath)
545		}
546	
547		identity = strings.Trim(identity, "/")
548		if host, remotePath, ok := strings.Cut(identity, "/"); ok {
549			return remoteIdentityKey(host, remotePath)
550		}
551		return ""
552	}
553	
554	func looksLikeLocalRemote(identity string) bool {
555		if filepath.IsAbs(identity) || strings.HasPrefix(identity, `\\`) {
556			return true
557		}
558		for _, prefix := range []string{"./", "../", "~/", `.\`, `..\`, `~\`} {
559			if strings.HasPrefix(identity, prefix) {
560				return true
561			}
562		}
563		if len(identity) >= 2 && identity[1] == ':' {
564			letter := identity[0]
565			if letter >= 'a' && letter <= 'z' || letter >= 'A' && letter <= 'Z' {
566				return true
567			}
568		}
569		return !strings.ContainsAny(identity, `/\:@`)
570	}
571	
572	func splitSCPLike(identity string) (string, string, bool) {
573		if strings.HasPrefix(identity, "[") {
574			if end := strings.Index(identity, "]:"); end >= 0 {
575				return identity[:end+1], identity[end+2:], true
576			}
577		}
578		colon := strings.IndexByte(identity, ':')
579		if colon <= 0 || strings.ContainsAny(identity[:colon], `/\\`) {
580			return "", "", false
581		}
582		return identity[:colon], identity[colon+1:], true
583	}
584	
585	func remoteIdentityKey(host, remotePath string) string {
586		host = strings.ToLower(strings.Trim(host, "/"))
587		remotePath = trimGitSuffix(strings.Trim(remotePath, "/"))
588		if host == "" || remotePath == "" {
589			return ""
590		}
591		return host + "/" + remotePath
592	}
593	
594	func trimGitSuffix(value string) string {
595		return strings.TrimSuffix(value, ".git")
596	}

131	// cdDirective asks the shell wrapper to move its parent process. The wrapper
132	// gives dev a child-only file descriptor so normal output stays connected to
133	// the terminal and an inherited environment variable can never name a file to
134	// overwrite. NUL terminates the path because filesystem paths may contain
135	// newlines. Without the wrapper, retain the printable directive used by older
136	// integrations.
137	func (a *App) cdDirective(dir string) error {
138		if rawFD := os.Getenv("DEV_SHELL_CD_FD"); rawFD != "" {
139			fd, err := strconv.Atoi(rawFD)
140			if err != nil || fd < 3 {
141				return fmt.Errorf("invalid DEV_SHELL_CD_FD %q", rawFD)
142			}
143			file := os.NewFile(uintptr(fd), "dev-shell-cd")
144			if file == nil {
145				return fmt.Errorf("invalid shell directory descriptor %d", fd)
146			}
147			if _, err := file.Write(append([]byte(dir), 0)); err != nil {
148				return fmt.Errorf("write shell directory directive: %w", err)
149			}
150			if err := file.Close(); err != nil {
151				return fmt.Errorf("close shell directory directive: %w", err)
152			}
153			return nil
154		}
155		_, err := fmt.Fprintf(a.Out, "cd %s\n", shellQuote(dir))
156		return err
157	}

258	// Load reads config.toml over the defaults. A missing file is not an error —
259	// dev must be useful with zero setup. A malformed file is, because silently
260	// falling back to defaults would send worktrees to the wrong volume.
261	func Load(path string) (Config, error) {
262		cfg := Default()
263		if path == "" {
264			path = ConfigFile()
265		}
266		md, err := toml.DecodeFile(path, &cfg)
267		switch {
268		case errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist):
269			return cfg, nil
270		case err != nil:
271			return cfg, fmt.Errorf("read %s: %w", path, err)
272		}
273		if undecoded := md.Undecoded(); len(undecoded) > 0 {
274			// Unknown keys are usually typos ("worktree_dir" vs "worktree_root").
275			// Warn rather than fail so a newer config still works on an older dev.
276			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "dev: warning: unknown key(s) in %s: %v\n", path, undecoded)
277		}
278		cfg.Source = path
279		return cfg, cfg.Validate()
280	}

282	// Validate catches the settings that would otherwise fail deep inside a
283	// worktree create, when a directory has already been made.
284	func (c Config) Validate() error {
285		switch c.Runtime.Backend {
286		case "", "auto", "herdr", "tmux", "none":
287		default:
288			return fmt.Errorf("runtime.backend %q: want auto, herdr, tmux or none", c.Runtime.Backend)
289		}
290		if c.Paths.WorktreePath == "" {
291			return errors.New("paths.worktree_path must not be empty")
292		}
293		if _, err := Render(c.Paths.WorktreePath, c.probeVars()); err != nil {
294			return fmt.Errorf("paths.worktree_path: %w", err)
295		}
296		switch c.Bootstrap.Layout {
297		case "", "flat", "preserve":
298		default:
299			return fmt.Errorf("bootstrap.layout %q: want flat or preserve", c.Bootstrap.Layout)
300		}
301		if c.Bootstrap.MaxDepth < 0 {
302			return fmt.Errorf("bootstrap.max_depth must be zero (unlimited) or positive")
303		}
304		if c.Forge.RemoteLimit < 0 {
305			return fmt.Errorf("forge.remote_limit must be zero (use default) or positive")
306		}
307		validStrategy := func(v string) bool {
308			switch v {
309			case "", "reinstall", "copy", "link", "skip":
310				return true
311			}
312			return false
313		}
314		if !validStrategy(c.Worktree.Strategy) {
315			return fmt.Errorf("worktree.strategy %q: want reinstall, copy, link or skip", c.Worktree.Strategy)
316		}
317		for ecosystem, strategy := range c.Worktree.Strategies {
318			if !validStrategy(strategy) {
319				return fmt.Errorf("worktree.strategies.%s %q: want reinstall, copy, link or skip",
320					ecosystem, strategy)
321			}
322		}
323		validColumns := map[string]bool{
324			"repo": true, "branch": true, "git": true, "remote": true, "size": true, "live": true,
325			"latest": true, "worktrees": true, "tasks": true,
326			"category": true, "path": true,
327		}
328		for i, column := range c.TUI.Repos.Columns {
329			if !validColumns[column] {
330				return fmt.Errorf("tui.repos.columns[%d] %q: unknown column", i, column)
331			}
332		}
333		switch c.EffectiveRepoSort() {
334		case "activity", "latest", "name", "git", "size", "tasks":
335		default:
336			return fmt.Errorf("tui.repos.sort %q: want activity, latest, name, git, size or tasks", c.TUI.Repos.Sort)
337		}
338		seen := map[string]string{}
339		for i, t := range c.TUI.Tools {
340			switch {
341			case t.Key == "":
342				return fmt.Errorf("tui.tools[%d]: key is required", i)
343			case t.Run == "":
344				return fmt.Errorf("tui.tools[%d] (%s): run is required", i, t.Key)
345			}
346			if binding, ok := ReservedKey(t.Key); ok {
347				return fmt.Errorf("tui.tools[%d]: key %q is the dashboard's %q binding; pick another",
348					i, t.Key, binding)
349			}
350			if prev, ok := seen[t.Key]; ok {
351				return fmt.Errorf("tui.tools[%d]: key %q is already bound to %q", i, t.Key, prev)
352			}
353			seen[t.Key] = t.Name
354		}
355		return nil
356	}

1	//go:build unix

13	
14	type catalogFileLock struct {
15		file *os.File
16	}
17	
18	func acquireCatalogFileLock(ctx context.Context, path string) (*catalogFileLock, error) {
19		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
20			return nil, err
21		}
22		file, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_CREATE|os.O_RDWR, 0o600)
23		if err != nil {
24			return nil, err
25		}
26		lock := &catalogFileLock{file: file}
27		ticker := time.NewTicker(10 * time.Millisecond)
28		defer ticker.Stop()
29		for {
30			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
31				_ = file.Close()
32				return nil, err
33			}
34			err = unix.Flock(int(file.Fd()), unix.LOCK_EX|unix.LOCK_NB)
35			if err == nil {
36				return lock, nil
37			}
38			if !errors.Is(err, unix.EWOULDBLOCK) && !errors.Is(err, unix.EAGAIN) && !errors.Is(err, unix.EINTR) {
39				_ = file.Close()
40				return nil, err
41			}
42			select {
43			case <-ctx.Done():
44				_ = file.Close()
45				return nil, ctx.Err()
46			case <-ticker.C:
47			}
48		}
49	}
50	
51	func (l *catalogFileLock) Close() error {
52		unlockErr := unix.Flock(int(l.file.Fd()), unix.LOCK_UN)
53		return errors.Join(unlockErr, l.file.Close())
54	}

1	//go:build windows
2	
3	package catalog
4	
5	import (
6		"context"
7		"errors"
8		"os"
9		"time"
10	
11		"golang.org/x/sys/windows"
12	)
13	
14	type catalogFileLock struct {
15		file       *os.File
16		overlapped windows.Overlapped
17	}
18	
19	func acquireCatalogFileLock(ctx context.Context, path string) (*catalogFileLock, error) {
20		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
21			return nil, err
22		}
23		file, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_CREATE|os.O_RDWR, 0o600)
24		if err != nil {
25			return nil, err
26		}
27		lock := &catalogFileLock{file: file}
28		ticker := time.NewTicker(10 * time.Millisecond)
29		defer ticker.Stop()
30		for {
31			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
32				_ = file.Close()
33				return nil, err
34			}
35			err = windows.LockFileEx(windows.Handle(file.Fd()),
36				windows.LOCKFILE_EXCLUSIVE_LOCK|windows.LOCKFILE_FAIL_IMMEDIATELY,
37				0, 1, 0, &lock.overlapped)
38			if err == nil {
39				return lock, nil
40			}
41			if !errors.Is(err, windows.ERROR_LOCK_VIOLATION) && !errors.Is(err, windows.ERROR_IO_PENDING) {
42				_ = file.Close()
43				return nil, err
44			}
45			select {
46			case <-ctx.Done():
47				_ = file.Close()
48				return nil, ctx.Err()
49			case <-ticker.C:
50			}
51		}
52	}
53	
54	func (l *catalogFileLock) Close() error {
55		unlockErr := windows.UnlockFileEx(windows.Handle(l.file.Fd()), 0, 1, 0, &l.overlapped)
56		return errors.Join(unlockErr, l.file.Close())
57	}

// Package note stores append-only repository thoughts as ordinary Markdown
// files. SQLite indexes them for search, but the files are the durable source
// of truth: readable without dev, syncable without database merge conflicts,
// and recoverable after every cache is deleted.
package note

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/catalog"
)

const CurrentSchemaVersion = 1

var (
	ErrNotFound   = errors.New("note not found")
	ErrInvalid    = errors.New("invalid note")
	ErrRepository = errors.New("invalid note repository")
)

// Note is one timestamped thought attached to a stable catalog asset ID.
type Note struct {
	SchemaVersion int       `toml:"schema_version" json:"schema_version"`
	ID            string    `toml:"id" json:"id"`
	RepositoryID  string    `toml:"repository_id" json:"repository_id"`
	Repository    string    `toml:"repository" json:"repository"`
	Created       time.Time `toml:"created" json:"created"`
	Updated       time.Time `toml:"updated" json:"updated"`
	Tags          []string  `toml:"tags" json:"tags"`

	Body string `toml:"-" json:"body"`
	Path string `toml:"-" json:"path,omitempty"`
}

func (n *Note) Normalize() {
	if n == nil {
		return
	}
	n.Repository = strings.TrimSpace(n.Repository)
	n.Body = normalizeBody(n.Body)
	n.Tags = catalog.NormalizeTags(n.Tags)
}

func (n Note) Validate() error {
	if n.SchemaVersion != CurrentSchemaVersion {
		return fmt.Errorf("note %s schema version %d: %w", n.ID, n.SchemaVersion, ErrInvalid)
	}
	if err := catalog.ValidateID(n.ID); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("note ID: %w", err)
	}
	if err := catalog.ValidateID(n.RepositoryID); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("repository ID: %w: %w", err, ErrRepository)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(n.Repository) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("note %s: repository name is required: %w", n.ID, ErrRepository)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(n.Body) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("note %s: body is empty: %w", n.ID, ErrInvalid)
	}
	if n.Created.IsZero() || n.Updated.IsZero() {
		return fmt.Errorf("note %s: created and updated are required: %w", n.ID, ErrInvalid)
	}
	if n.Updated.Before(n.Created) {
		return fmt.Errorf("note %s: updated precedes created: %w", n.ID, ErrInvalid)
	}
	return nil
}

// Preview returns the first non-empty body line, collapsed and truncated.
func (n Note) Preview(limit int) string {
	line := ""
	for _, candidate := range strings.Split(n.Body, "\n") {
		if strings.TrimSpace(candidate) != "" {
			line = strings.Join(strings.Fields(candidate), " ")
			break
		}
	}
	if limit <= 0 || len([]rune(line)) <= limit {
		return line
	}
	runes := []rune(line)
	return string(runes[:limit-1]) + "…"
}

func normalizeBody(body string) string {
	body = strings.ReplaceAll(body, "\r\n", "\n")
	body = strings.TrimSpace(body)
	if body == "" {
		return ""
	}
	return body + "\n"
}
EOF

package note

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/BurntSushi/toml"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

const delimiter = "+++"

type IDGenerator func() string
type DiagnosticSink func(path string, err error)
type StoreOption func(*Store)

func WithIDGenerator(fn IDGenerator) StoreOption { return func(s *Store) { s.generateID = fn } }
func WithClock(fn func() time.Time) StoreOption   { return func(s *Store) { s.clock = fn } }
func WithDiagnosticSink(fn DiagnosticSink) StoreOption {
	return func(s *Store) { s.diagnostics = fn }
}

// Store owns the durable Markdown note tree.
type Store struct {
	Dir string

	mu          sync.Mutex
	generateID  IDGenerator
	clock       func() time.Time
	diagnostics DiagnosticSink
}

func NewStore(dir string, options ...StoreOption) *Store {
	s := &Store{Dir: dir, generateID: uuid.NewString, clock: time.Now}
	for _, option := range options {
		if option != nil {
			option(s)
		}
	}
	return s
}

func (s *Store) Create(ctx context.Context, repositoryID, repositoryName, body string, tags []string) (*Note, error) {
	if ctx == nil {
		ctx = context.Background()
	}
	n := &Note{
		SchemaVersion: CurrentSchemaVersion,
		RepositoryID: repositoryID,
		Repository: repositoryName,
		Body: body,
		Tags: tags,
	}
	n.Normalize()
	if n.Body == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("create note: body is empty: %w", ErrInvalid)
	}

	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	var created *Note
	err := s.withFileLock(ctx, func() error {
		for range 32 {
			candidate := *n
			candidate.ID = s.nextID()
			now := s.now()
			candidate.Created, candidate.Updated = now, now
			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			path := s.path(candidate.RepositoryID, candidate.ID)
			if _, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil {
				continue
			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
				return err
			}
			candidate.Path = path
			if err := s.writeAtomic(&candidate); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			created = clone(&candidate)
			return nil
		}
		return errors.New("generate unique note ID: too many collisions")
	})
	return created, err
}

func (s *Store) Get(id string) (*Note, error) {
	if id == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty note ID: %w", ErrNotFound)
	}
	paths, err := s.notePaths("")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var match string
	for _, path := range paths {
		if strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(path), ".md") == id {
			if match != "" {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("duplicate note ID %s", id)
			}
			match = path
		}
	}
	if match == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
	}
	return s.read(match)
}

// List returns notes newest-first. Empty repositoryID means all repositories.
func (s *Store) List(repositoryID string) ([]*Note, error) {
	paths, err := s.notePaths(repositoryID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var notes []*Note
	for _, path := range paths {
		n, err := s.read(path)
		if err != nil {
			if s.diagnostics != nil {
				s.diagnostics(path, err)
			}
			continue
		}
		notes = append(notes, n)
	}
	Sort(notes)
	return notes, nil
}

// Update replaces body/tags while preserving identity, repository and Created.
func (s *Store) Update(ctx context.Context, id, body string, tags []string) (*Note, error) {
	if ctx == nil {
		ctx = context.Background()
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	var updated *Note
	err := s.withFileLock(ctx, func() error {
		current, err := s.Get(id)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		candidate := *current
		candidate.Body, candidate.Tags, candidate.Updated = body, tags, s.now()
		candidate.Normalize()
		if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := s.writeAtomic(&candidate); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		updated = clone(&candidate)
		return nil
	})
	return updated, err
}

func (s *Store) Delete(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
	if ctx == nil {
		ctx = context.Background()
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	return s.withFileLock(ctx, func() error {
		n, err := s.Get(id)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := os.Remove(n.Path); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		// Empty repository directories are noise and carry no identity of their own.
		_ = os.Remove(filepath.Dir(n.Path))
		return nil
	})
}

func (s *Store) Path(repositoryID string) string {
	if repositoryID == "" {
		return s.Dir
	}
	return filepath.Join(s.Dir, repositoryID)
}

func Sort(notes []*Note) {
	sort.SliceStable(notes, func(i, j int) bool {
		if !notes[i].Created.Equal(notes[j].Created) {
			return notes[i].Created.After(notes[j].Created)
		}
		return notes[i].ID < notes[j].ID
	})
}

func (s *Store) read(path string) (*Note, error) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	meta, body, err := split(data)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("read %s: %w", filepath.Base(path), err)
	}
	var n Note
	md, err := toml.Decode(string(meta), &n)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode %s frontmatter: %w", filepath.Base(path), err)
	}
	if unknown := md.Undecoded(); len(unknown) > 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode %s: unknown field(s): %v", filepath.Base(path), unknown)
	}
	n.Body, n.Path = string(body), path
	n.Normalize()
	if err := n.Validate(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if want := strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(path), ".md"); n.ID != want {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("note ID %s does not match filename %s: %w", n.ID, want, ErrInvalid)
	}
	if want := filepath.Base(filepath.Dir(path)); n.RepositoryID != want {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("repository ID %s does not match directory %s: %w", n.RepositoryID, want, ErrRepository)
	}
	return &n, nil
}

func (s *Store) writeAtomic(n *Note) error {
	dir := filepath.Dir(n.Path)
	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var front bytes.Buffer
	if err := toml.NewEncoder(&front).Encode(n); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	content := delimiter + "\n" + front.String() + delimiter + "\n\n" + n.Body
	tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(dir, "."+n.ID+".*.tmp")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	name := tmp.Name()
	defer os.Remove(name)
	if _, err := tmp.WriteString(content); err != nil {
		_ = tmp.Close()
		return err
	}
	if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := os.Chmod(name, 0o644); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return os.Rename(name, n.Path)
}

func split(data []byte) ([]byte, []byte, error) {
	if !bytes.HasPrefix(data, []byte(delimiter+"\n")) {
		return nil, nil, errors.New("missing opening +++ frontmatter delimiter")
	}
	rest := data[len(delimiter)+1:]
	marker := []byte("\n" + delimiter + "\n")
	i := bytes.Index(rest, marker)
	if i < 0 {
		return nil, nil, errors.New("missing closing +++ frontmatter delimiter")
	}
	meta := rest[:i]
	body := rest[i+len(marker):]
	body = bytes.TrimPrefix(body, []byte("\n"))
	return meta, body, nil
}

func (s *Store) notePaths(repositoryID string) ([]string, error) {
	root := s.Dir
	if repositoryID != "" {
		root = filepath.Join(root, repositoryID)
	}
	var paths []string
	err := filepath.WalkDir(root, func(path string, entry fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil {
			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
				return nil
			}
			return err
		}
		if entry.IsDir() || strings.HasPrefix(entry.Name(), ".") || !strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".md") {
			return nil
		}
		paths = append(paths, path)
		return nil
	})
	if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
		return nil, nil
	}
	sort.Strings(paths)
	return paths, err
}

func (s *Store) path(repositoryID, id string) string {
	return filepath.Join(s.Dir, repositoryID, id+".md")
}

func (s *Store) nextID() string {
	if s.generateID == nil {
		return uuid.NewString()
	}
	return s.generateID()
}

func (s *Store) now() time.Time {
	if s.clock == nil {
		return time.Now().UTC()
	}
	return s.clock().UTC()
}

func clone(n *Note) *Note {
	if n == nil {
		return nil
	}
	out := *n
	out.Tags = append([]string(nil), n.Tags...)
	return &out
}
EOF

//go:build unix

package note

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"time"

	"golang.org/x/sys/unix"
)

type noteFileLock struct{ file *os.File }

func acquireNoteFileLock(ctx context.Context, path string) (*noteFileLock, error) {
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	file, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_CREATE|os.O_RDWR, 0o600)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	lock := &noteFileLock{file: file}
	ticker := time.NewTicker(10 * time.Millisecond)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
			_ = file.Close()
			return nil, err
		}
		err = unix.Flock(int(file.Fd()), unix.LOCK_EX|unix.LOCK_NB)
		if err == nil {
			return lock, nil
		}
		if !errors.Is(err, unix.EWOULDBLOCK) && !errors.Is(err, unix.EAGAIN) && !errors.Is(err, unix.EINTR) {
			_ = file.Close()
			return nil, err
		}
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			_ = file.Close()
			return nil, ctx.Err()
		case <-ticker.C:
		}
	}
}

func (l *noteFileLock) Close() error {
	unlockErr := unix.Flock(int(l.file.Fd()), unix.LOCK_UN)
	return errors.Join(unlockErr, l.file.Close())
}
EOF

//go:build windows

package note

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"time"

	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"
)

type noteFileLock struct {
	file       *os.File
	overlapped windows.Overlapped
}

func acquireNoteFileLock(ctx context.Context, path string) (*noteFileLock, error) {
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	file, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_CREATE|os.O_RDWR, 0o600)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	lock := &noteFileLock{file: file}
	ticker := time.NewTicker(10 * time.Millisecond)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
			_ = file.Close()
			return nil, err
		}
		err = windows.LockFileEx(windows.Handle(file.Fd()),
			windows.LOCKFILE_EXCLUSIVE_LOCK|windows.LOCKFILE_FAIL_IMMEDIATELY,
			0, 1, 0, &lock.overlapped)
		if err == nil {
			return lock, nil
		}
		if !errors.Is(err, windows.ERROR_LOCK_VIOLATION) && !errors.Is(err, windows.ERROR_IO_PENDING) {
			_ = file.Close()
			return nil, err
		}
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			_ = file.Close()
			return nil, ctx.Err()
		case <-ticker.C:
		}
	}
}

func (l *noteFileLock) Close() error {
	unlockErr := windows.UnlockFileEx(windows.Handle(l.file.Fd()), 0, 1, 0, &l.overlapped)
	return errors.Join(unlockErr, l.file.Close())
}

func (s *Store) withFileLock(ctx context.Context, operation func() error) (err error) {
	if err := os.MkdirAll(s.Dir, 0o755); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	absolute, err := filepath.Abs(s.Dir)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	canonical, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(absolute)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	lockPath := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(canonical), "."+filepath.Base(canonical)+".lock")
	lock, err := acquireNoteFileLock(ctx, lockPath)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { err = errors.Join(err, lock.Close()) }()
	return operation()
}
EOF

import (
	"context"

	"path/filepath"

	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/note"
)

const (
	repoID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	noteID = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
)

func fixedTime() time.Time {
	return time.Date(2026, time.August, 27, 10, 30, 0, 0, time.FixedZone("test", 8*60*60))
}

func store(t *testing.T, diagnostics *[]string) *note.Store {
	t.Helper()
	return note.NewStore(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "notes"),
		note.WithIDGenerator(func() string { return noteID }),
		note.WithClock(fixedTime),
		note.WithDiagnosticSink(func(path string, err error) {
			if diagnostics != nil {
				*diagnostics = append(*diagnostics, filepath.Base(path)+": "+err.Error())
			}
		}),
	)
}

func TestCreateWritesReadableMarkdown(t *testing.T) {
	var diagnostics []string
	s := store(t, &diagnostics)
	created, err := s.Create(context.Background(), repoID, "  dev-cli  ",
		"  Try an event subscription.  ", []string{" Idea ", "git", "IDEA", ""})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if created.ID != noteID || created.RepositoryID != repoID || created.Repository != "dev-cli" {
		t.Errorf("identity = %+v", created)
	}
	if created.Body != "Try an event subscription.\n" {
		t.Errorf("body = %q", created.Body)
	}
	if want := []string{"git", "idea"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(created.Tags, want) {
		t.Errorf("tags = %v, want %v", created.Tags, want)
	}
	if created.Created.Location() != time.UTC || !created.Created.Equal(fixedTime().UTC()) {
		t.Errorf("created = %v", created.Created)
	}

	body, err := os.ReadFile(created.Path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	text := string(body)
	if !strings.HasPrefix(text, "+++\n") || !strings.Contains(text, "\n+++\n\nTry an event") {

package note

import (
	"database/sql"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"

	_ "modernc.org/sqlite"
)

// Index is a disposable FTS5 database over durable Markdown notes.
type Index struct {
	Path string
	db   *sql.DB
}

func OpenIndex(path string) (*Index, error) {
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	db, err := sql.Open("sqlite", path+"?_pragma=busy_timeout(5000)&_pragma=journal_mode(WAL)")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	i := &Index{Path: path, db: db}
	if err := i.migrate(); err != nil {
		_ = db.Close()
		return nil, err
	}
	return i, nil
}

func (i *Index) Close() error { return i.db.Close() }

func (i *Index) migrate() error {
	_, err := i.db.Exec(`
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notes_fts USING fts5(
  id UNINDEXED,
  repository_id UNINDEXED,
  repository,
  tags,
  body,
  tokenize = 'unicode61'
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS note_manifest (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  updated TEXT NOT NULL
);`)
	return err
}

// Hit is one ranked search match.
type Hit struct {
	ID           string `json:"id"`
	RepositoryID string `json:"repository_id"`
	Repository   string `json:"repository"`
	Snippet      string `json:"snippet"`
}

// Rebuild replaces the complete derived index in one transaction.
func (i *Index) Rebuild(notes []*Note) error {
	tx, err := i.db.Begin()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer tx.Rollback()
	if _, err := tx.Exec("DELETE FROM notes_fts"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err := tx.Exec("DELETE FROM note_manifest"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	fts, err := tx.Prepare("INSERT INTO notes_fts (id, repository_id, repository, tags, body) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer fts.Close()
	manifest, err := tx.Prepare("INSERT INTO note_manifest (id, updated) VALUES (?, ?)")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer manifest.Close()
	for _, n := range notes {
		if _, err := fts.Exec(n.ID, n.RepositoryID, n.Repository, strings.Join(n.Tags, " "), n.Body); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if _, err := manifest.Exec(n.ID, stamp(n.Updated)); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return tx.Commit()
}

// Upsert incrementally updates one note after a create/edit.
func (i *Index) Upsert(n *Note) error {
	tx, err := i.db.Begin()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer tx.Rollback()
	if _, err := tx.Exec("DELETE FROM notes_fts WHERE id = ?", n.ID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err := tx.Exec(`INSERT INTO notes_fts
(id, repository_id, repository, tags, body) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
		n.ID, n.RepositoryID, n.Repository, strings.Join(n.Tags, " "), n.Body); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err := tx.Exec(`INSERT INTO note_manifest (id, updated) VALUES (?, ?)
ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET updated = excluded.updated`, n.ID, stamp(n.Updated)); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return tx.Commit()
}

func (i *Index) Delete(id string) error {
	tx, err := i.db.Begin()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer tx.Rollback()
	if _, err := tx.Exec("DELETE FROM notes_fts WHERE id = ?", id); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err := tx.Exec("DELETE FROM note_manifest WHERE id = ?", id); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return tx.Commit()
}

// Current reports whether the manifest exactly matches the durable notes.
func (i *Index) Current(notes []*Note) bool {
	rows, err := i.db.Query("SELECT id, updated FROM note_manifest")
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	manifest := map[string]string{}
	for rows.Next() {
		var id, updated string
		if rows.Scan(&id, &updated) != nil {
			return false
		}
		manifest[id] = updated
	}
	if len(manifest) != len(notes) {
		return false
	}
	for _, n := range notes {
		if manifest[n.ID] != stamp(n.Updated) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

// Ensure rebuilds only when source and manifest differ.
func (i *Index) Ensure(notes []*Note) error {
	if i.Current(notes) {
		return nil
	}
	return i.Rebuild(notes)
}

// Search performs term-wise prefix search. Literal quoting prevents punctuation
// in a quick thought from becoming accidental FTS syntax.
func (i *Index) Search(query, repositoryID string, limit int) ([]Hit, error) {
	query = ftsQuery(query)
	if query == "" {
		return nil, nil
	}
	if limit <= 0 {
		limit = 100
	}
	statement := `SELECT id, repository_id, repository,
  snippet(notes_fts, 4, '[', ']', '…', 16)
FROM notes_fts WHERE notes_fts MATCH ?`
	args := []any{query}
	if repositoryID != "" {
		statement += " AND repository_id = ?"
		args = append(args, repositoryID)
	}
	statement += " ORDER BY rank LIMIT ?"
	args = append(args, limit)
	rows, err := i.db.Query(statement, args...)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("search notes: %w", err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	var hits []Hit
	for rows.Next() {
		var h Hit
		if err := rows.Scan(&h.ID, &h.RepositoryID, &h.Repository, &h.Snippet); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		hits = append(hits, h)
	}
	return hits, rows.Err()
}

func ftsQuery(query string) string {
	var terms []string
	for _, term := range strings.Fields(query) {
		term = strings.ReplaceAll(term, `"`, `""`)
		if term != "" {
			terms = append(terms, `"`+term+`"*`)
		}
	}
	return strings.Join(terms, " AND ")
}

func stamp(t time.Time) string { return t.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano) }

// SortHits provides a deterministic fallback for callers that combine result
// sets. FTS Search itself returns rank order.
func SortHits(hits []Hit) {
	sort.SliceStable(hits, func(a, b int) bool {
		if hits[a].Repository != hits[b].Repository {
			return hits[a].Repository < hits[b].Repository
		}
		return hits[a].ID < hits[b].ID
	})
}
EOF

// Current reports whether the manifest exactly matches the durable notes.
func (i *Index) Current(notes []*Note) bool {
	rows, err := i.db.Query("SELECT id, updated FROM note_manifest")
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	manifest := map[string]string{}
	for rows.Next() {
		var id, updated string
		if rows.Scan(&id, &updated) != nil {
			return false
		}
		manifest[id] = updated
	}
	if len(manifest) != len(notes) {
		return false
	}
	for _, n := range notes {
		if manifest[n.ID] != stamp(n.Updated) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

// Ensure rebuilds only when source and manifest differ.
func (i *Index) Ensure(notes []*Note) error {
	if i.Current(notes) {
		return nil
	}
	return i.Rebuild(notes)
}

// Search performs term-wise prefix search. Literal quoting prevents punctuation
// in a quick thought from becoming accidental FTS syntax.
func (i *Index) Search(query, repositoryID string, limit int) ([]Hit, error) {
	rawQuery := strings.TrimSpace(query)
	if rawQuery == "" {
		return nil, nil
	}
	if limit <= 0 {
		limit = 100
	}
	// unicode61 does not segment CJK words: a body token "記得改善" cannot
	// match the substring "改善". Use term-wise literal LIKE for non-ASCII
	// input while retaining FTS ranking/snippets for Latin-script searches.
	if containsNonASCII(rawQuery) {
		return i.searchLiteral(rawQuery, repositoryID, limit)
	}
	query = ftsQuery(rawQuery)
	if query == "" {
		return nil, nil
	}
	statement := `SELECT id, repository_id, repository,
  snippet(notes_fts, 4, '[', ']', '…', 16)
FROM notes_fts WHERE notes_fts MATCH ?`
	args := []any{query}
	if repositoryID != "" {
		statement += " AND repository_id = ?"
		args = append(args, repositoryID)
	}
	statement += " ORDER BY rank LIMIT ?"
	args = append(args, limit)
	rows, err := i.db.Query(statement, args...)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("search notes: %w", err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	var hits []Hit
	for rows.Next() {
		var h Hit
		if err := rows.Scan(&h.ID, &h.RepositoryID, &h.Repository, &h.Snippet); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		hits = append(hits, h)
	}
	return hits, rows.Err()
}

func containsNonASCII(s string) bool {
	for _, r := range s {
		if r > 127 {
			return true
		}
	}

package note

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
)

// Service keeps durable file operations and the disposable index in sync.
type Service struct {
	Store     *Store
	IndexPath string
	// IndexDiagnostic reports an incremental index failure after the durable
	// file operation already succeeded. Search/reindex return index errors
	// directly because they have no useful result without it.
	IndexDiagnostic func(error)
}

func NewService(store *Store, indexPath string) *Service {
	return &Service{Store: store, IndexPath: indexPath}
}

func (s *Service) Add(ctx context.Context, repositoryID, repository, body string, tags []string) (*Note, error) {
	n, err := s.Store.Create(ctx, repositoryID, repository, body, tags)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	s.updateIndex(func(i *Index) error { return i.Upsert(n) })
	return n, nil
}

func (s *Service) List(repositoryID string) ([]*Note, error) {
	return s.Store.List(repositoryID)
}

func (s *Service) Get(id string) (*Note, error) { return s.Store.Get(id) }

func (s *Service) Update(ctx context.Context, id, body string, tags []string) (*Note, error) {
	n, err := s.Store.Update(ctx, id, body, tags)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	s.updateIndex(func(i *Index) error { return i.Upsert(n) })
	return n, nil
}

func (s *Service) Delete(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
	if err := s.Store.Delete(ctx, id); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	s.updateIndex(func(i *Index) error { return i.Delete(id) })
	return nil
}

func (s *Service) Search(query, repositoryID string, limit int) ([]*Note, error) {
	notes, err := s.Store.List("")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	i, err := OpenIndex(s.IndexPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer i.Close()
	if err := i.Ensure(notes); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	hits, err := i.Search(query, repositoryID, limit)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	byID := make(map[string]*Note, len(notes))
	for _, n := range notes {
		byID[n.ID] = n
	}
	out := make([]*Note, 0, len(hits))
	for _, hit := range hits {
		if n := byID[hit.ID]; n != nil {
			out = append(out, clone(n))
		}
	}
	return out, nil
}

func (s *Service) Reindex() (int, error) {
	notes, err := s.Store.List("")
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	i, err := OpenIndex(s.IndexPath)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	defer i.Close()
	if err := i.Rebuild(notes); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	return len(notes), nil
}

// ClearIndex removes SQLite and its WAL sidecars. Durable Markdown notes are
// deliberately outside this path and remain untouched.
func (s *Service) ClearIndex() error {
	var err error
	for _, suffix := range []string{"", "-wal", "-shm"} {
		if removeErr := os.Remove(s.IndexPath + suffix); removeErr != nil && !os.IsNotExist(removeErr) {
			err = fmt.Errorf("remove notes index%s: %w", suffix, removeErr)
		}
	}
	return err
}

func (s *Service) updateIndex(operation func(*Index) error) {
	i, err := OpenIndex(s.IndexPath)
	if err == nil {
		err = operation(i)
		err = errors.Join(err, i.Close())
	}
	if err != nil && s.IndexDiagnostic != nil {
		s.IndexDiagnostic(err)
	}
}
EOF

115	func cacheInfo(path string) (size int64, modified time.Time, exists bool) {
116		info, err := os.Stat(path)
117		if err != nil {
118			return 0, time.Time{}, false
119		}
120		exists, modified = true, info.ModTime()
121		if !info.IsDir() {
122			return info.Size(), modified, true
123		}
124		_ = filepath.WalkDir(path, func(p string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
125			if err != nil || d.IsDir() {
126				return nil
127			}
128			if i, err := d.Info(); err == nil {
129				size += i.Size()
130				if i.ModTime().After(modified) {
131					modified = i.ModTime()
132				}
133			}
134			return nil
135		})
136		return size, modified, true
137	}
138	
139	func humanBytes(n int64) string {
140		const unit = 1024
141		switch {
142		case n < unit:
143			return fmt.Sprintf("%dB", n)
144		case n < unit*unit:
145			return fmt.Sprintf("%.1fK", float64(n)/unit)
146		case n < unit*unit*unit:
147			return fmt.Sprintf("%.1fM", float64(n)/(unit*unit))
148		default:
149			return fmt.Sprintf("%.1fG", float64(n)/(unit*unit*unit))
150		}
151	}

65	func configEditorProcess(app *App, editor string) (*exec.Cmd, string, bool, error) {
66		path := app.configPath

68			path = config.ConfigFile()

86		info, err := os.Stat(path)
87		switch {
88		case err == nil && info.IsDir():

90		case err == nil:
91			return false, nil
92		case !os.IsNotExist(err):
93			return false, err
94		}
95		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
96			return false, err
97		}
98		body := renderStarterConfig(config.DetectLayout().Fallbacks())
99		if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(body), 0o644); err != nil {
100			return false, err
101		}
102		return true, nil
103	}

112			if _, err := exec.LookPath(candidate); err == nil {
113				return candidate, nil
114			}
115		}
116		return "", fmt.Errorf("no editor found; set $VISUAL or $EDITOR, or pass --editor")
117	}

292	func patchRepositoryCatalog(ctx context.Context, app *App, repository repo.Repo, add, remove []string, note *string) (*catalog.Entry, error) {
293		commonDir := repository.CommonDir
294		realPath := repository.RealPath
295		if discovered, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, repository.Path); discoverErr == nil {
296			if commonDir == "" {
297				commonDir = discovered.GitCommonDir
298			}
299			if realPath == "" {
300				realPath = discovered.Root
301			}
302		}
303		observation := catalog.Observation{
304			Host: config.Hostname(), Path: repository.Path, RealPath: realPath,
305			CommonDir: commonDir, Name: repository.Name,
306			RemoteIdentity: gitx.RemoteFromConfig(commonDir, "origin"),
307		}
308		add = catalog.NormalizeTags(add)
309		remove = catalog.NormalizeTags(remove)
310		var marked *catalog.Entry
311		err := app.Catalog.WithLock(ctx, func() error {
312			entry, ensureErr := app.Registry.EnsureRepository(observation)
313			if ensureErr != nil {
314				return ensureErr
315			}
316			marked, ensureErr = app.Registry.Patch(entry.ID, func(candidate *catalog.Entry) error {
317				kept := make([]string, 0, len(candidate.Tags)+len(add))
318				for _, tag := range candidate.Tags {
319					if !slices.Contains(remove, tag) {
320						kept = append(kept, tag)
321					}
322				}
323				candidate.Tags = append(kept, add...)
324				if note != nil {
325					candidate.Note = *note
326				}
327				return nil
328			})
329			return ensureErr
330		})
331		return marked, err
332	}

func newNoteCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
	cmd := &cobra.Command{
		Use:   "note",
		Short: "Capture and search append-only thoughts beside repositories",
		Long: `Store quick thoughts outside the repository as ordinary Markdown files,
keyed by the repository's stable catalog ID. The files under
$XDG_DATA_HOME/dev/notes are durable truth; SQLite under $XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev
is only a rebuildable FTS search index.

Use n in the TUI for quick add and N for the notes overlay.`,
	}
	cmd.AddCommand(
		newNoteAddCmd(app), newNoteListCmd(app), newNoteShowCmd(app),
		newNoteSearchCmd(app), newNoteEditCmd(app), newNoteDeleteCmd(app),
		newNotePathCmd(app), newNoteReindexCmd(app),
	)
	return cmd
}

func newNoteAddCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
	var (
		repoRef string
		tags    []string
		editor  bool
		editorCommand string
	)
	cmd := &cobra.Command{
		Use:   "add [thought...]",
		Short: "Append one thought to a repository",
		Long: `Create one timestamped Markdown note. Run inside a repo, or pass --repo.
Text arguments form a quick one-line thought; --editor opens a temporary body
and atomically saves it only after the editor exits with a non-empty result.`,
		Args: cobra.ArbitraryArgs,
		RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
			entry, _, err := noteRepository(ctxOf(), app, repoRef)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			body := strings.TrimSpace(strings.Join(args, " "))
			if editor {
				body, err = editNoteBody(body, editorCommand)
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
			if body == "" {
				return fmt.Errorf("note body is empty; provide text or use --editor")
			}
			n, err := app.Notes.Add(ctxOf(), entry.ID, entry.Title(), body, tags)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s  %s\n  %s\n", n.ID, n.Repository, n.Preview(100))
			return nil
		},
	}
	f := cmd.Flags()
	f.StringVarP(&repoRef, "repo", "r", "", "repository (default: repo containing cwd)")
	f.StringArrayVarP(&tags, "tag", "t", nil, "tag (repeatable)")
	f.BoolVarP(&editor, "editor", "e", false, "compose the body in VISUAL/EDITOR")
	f.StringVar(&editorCommand, "editor-command", "", "editor command override")
	return cmd
}

func newNoteListCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
	var (

	)
	cmd := &cobra.Command{
		Use:   "list [repo]",
		Short: "List notes newest-first",
		Args:  cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),
		RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
			repositoryID := ""
			if !all {
				ref := ""
				if len(args) == 1 {
					ref = args[0]
				}
				entry, _, err := noteRepository(ctxOf(), app, ref)
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				repositoryID = entry.ID
			} else if len(args) > 0 {
				return fmt.Errorf("repo argument and --all are alternatives")
			}
			notes, err := app.Notes.List(repositoryID)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if tag != "" {
				filtered := notes[:0]
				for _, n := range notes {
					if containsString(n.Tags, strings.ToLower(tag)) {
						filtered = append(filtered, n)
					}
				}
				notes = filtered
			}
			return renderNotes(app, notes, jsonOut)
		},
	}
	f := cmd.Flags()
	f.BoolVarP(&all, "all", "a", false, "all repositories")
	f.BoolVar(&jsonOut, "json", false, "emit JSON")
	f.StringVarP(&tag, "tag", "t", "", "only notes with this tag")
	return cmd
}

func newNoteDeleteCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
	var yes bool
	cmd := &cobra.Command{
		Use:     "delete <note-id>",
		Aliases: []string{"rm"},
		Short:   "Delete one note after confirmation",
		Args:    cobra.ExactArgs(1),
		RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
			n, err := resolveNote(app, args[0])
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if !yes {
				if !app.interactive() {
					return fmt.Errorf("refusing to delete note non-interactively without --yes")
				}

				}

			if err := app.Notes.Delete(ctxOf(), n.ID); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "deleted %s\n", n.ID)
			return nil
		},
	}
	cmd.Flags().BoolVarP(&yes, "yes", "y", false, "do not prompt")
	return cmd
}

func noteRepository(ctx context.Context, app *App, ref string) (*catalog.Entry, repo.Repo, error) {
	var r repo.Repo
	if ref != "" {
		// A stable catalog ID is accepted anywhere a repo name is.
		if entry, err := app.Registry.Get(ref); err == nil {
			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(config.Hostname())
			if !ok || location.CurrentPath == "" {
				return nil, r, fmt.Errorf("catalog repository %s has no path on this host", ref)
			}
			r = repo.Repo{Name: entry.Name, Path: location.CurrentPath,
				RealPath: location.RealPath, CommonDir: location.GitCommonDir, HasGit: true}
			return entry, r, nil
		}
		resolved, _, err := resolveRepoRef(app, ref)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, r, err
		}
		r = resolved
	} else {
		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, r, err
		}
		g, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, cwd)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, r, fmt.Errorf("%s is not in a repository; pass --repo", config.Contract(cwd))
		}
		r = repo.Repo{Name: g.Name, Path: g.MainRoot, RealPath: g.MainRoot,
			CommonDir: g.GitCommonDir, MainRoot: g.MainRoot, HasGit: true}
	}
	if r.RealPath == "" || r.CommonDir == "" {
		if g, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, r.Path); err == nil {
			if r.RealPath == "" {
				r.RealPath = g.MainRoot
			}
			if r.CommonDir == "" {
				r.CommonDir = g.GitCommonDir
			}
		}
	}
	observation := catalog.Observation{
		Host: config.Hostname(), Path: r.Path, RealPath: r.RealPath,
		CommonDir: r.CommonDir, Name: r.Name,
		RemoteIdentity: gitx.RemoteFromConfig(r.CommonDir, "origin"),
	}
	var entry *catalog.Entry
	err := app.Catalog.WithLock(ctx, func() error {
		var ensureErr error
		entry, ensureErr = app.Registry.EnsureRepository(observation)
		return ensureErr
	})
	return entry, r, err
}

func resolveNote(app *App, ref string) (*note.Note, error) {
	if n, err := app.Notes.Get(ref); err == nil {
		return n, nil
	}
	notes, err := app.Notes.List("")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var hits []*note.Note
	for _, n := range notes {
		if strings.HasPrefix(n.ID, ref) {
			hits = append(hits, n)
		}
	}
	switch len(hits) {
	case 1:
		return hits[0], nil
	case 0:
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", ref, note.ErrNotFound)
	default:
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("note prefix %q is ambiguous (%d matches)", ref, len(hits))
	}
}

func renderNotes(app *App, notes []*note.Note, jsonOut bool) error {
	if jsonOut {
		enc := json.NewEncoder(app.Out)
		enc.SetIndent("", "  ")
		return enc.Encode(notes)
	}
	if len(notes) == 0 {
		fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "No notes.")
		return nil
	}
	t := NewTable("ID", "WHEN", "REPO", "TAGS", "THOUGHT")
	for _, n := range notes {
		t.Add(n.ID[:8], humanAge(time.Since(n.Created)), n.Repository,
			dash(strings.Join(n.Tags, ",")), truncate(n.Preview(80), 80))
	}
	t.Render(app.Out)
	return nil
}

func editNoteBody(initial, editorOverride string) (string, error) {
	tmp, err := os.CreateTemp("", "dev-note-*.md")
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	path := tmp.Name()
	defer os.Remove(path)
	if _, err := io.WriteString(tmp, initial); err != nil {
		_ = tmp.Close()
		return "", err
	}
	if !strings.HasSuffix(initial, "\n") {
		_, _ = io.WriteString(tmp, "\n")
	}
	if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	proc, chosen, err := editorProcess(path, editorOverride)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	proc.Stdin, proc.Stdout, proc.Stderr = os.Stdin, os.Stdout, os.Stderr
	if err := proc.Run(); err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("editor %q: %w", chosen, err)
	}
	body, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(string(body)) == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("edited note body is empty; not saved")
	}
	return string(body), nil
}

func containsString(values []string, value string) bool {
	for _, candidate := range values {
		if candidate == value {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

		t.Errorf("note path = %q", out)
	}
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(out)
	if err != nil || len(entries) != 1 || entries[0].Name() != id+".md" {
		t.Errorf("durable source entries=%v err=%v", entries, err)
	}
}

func TestNoteSearchRebuildsAfterCacheClear(t *testing.T) {
	h := newHarness(t)
	out := h.mustRun("note", "add", "survive index deletion", "--repo", "demo")
	id := strings.Fields(out)[0]
	if out = h.mustRun("note", "search", "survive"); !strings.Contains(out, id[:8]) {
		t.Fatal("initial search did not find note")
	}
	index := filepath.Join(config.CacheHome(), "dev", "notes.db")
	if _, err := os.Stat(index); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("search index not created: %v", err)
	}
	h.mustRun("cache", "clear", "notes")
	if _, err := os.Stat(index); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		t.Error("cache should be gone")
	}
	out = h.mustRun("note", "search", "survive")
	if !strings.Contains(out, id[:8]) {
		t.Errorf("search should rebuild from Markdown: %q", out)
	}
}

func TestNoteEditUsesTemporaryBodyAndPreservesMetadata(t *testing.T) {
	h := newHarness(t)
	out := h.mustRun("note", "add", "original thought", "--repo", "demo", "--tag", "idea")
	id := strings.Fields(out)[0]
	editor := filepath.Join(h.home, "note-editor")
	if err := os.WriteFile(editor, []byte("#!/bin/sh\nprintf 'revised by editor\\n' > \"$1\"\n"), 0o755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	out = h.mustRun("note", "edit", id[:8], "--editor", editor)
	if !strings.Contains(out, "revised by editor") {
		t.Errorf("edit output: %q", out)
	}
	out = h.mustRun("note", "show", id, "--json")
	if !strings.Contains(out, `"body":"revised by editor\n"`) || !strings.Contains(out, `"idea"`) {
		t.Errorf("body changed but tags should survive: %q", out)
	}
}

func TestNoteDeleteRequiresYesOutsideTTY(t *testing.T) {
	h := newHarness(t)
	out := h.mustRun("note", "add", "delete me", "--repo", "demo")
	id := strings.Fields(out)[0]
	if _, _, err := h.run("note", "delete", id[:8]); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "without --yes") {
		t.Errorf("noninteractive delete should be refused, got %v", err)
	}
	h.mustRun("note", "delete", id[:8], "--yes")
	if out := h.mustRun("note", "list", "demo"); !strings.Contains(out, "No notes") {
		t.Errorf("deleted note remains: %q", out)
	}
}

func TestNoteAddEditorAndEmptyBodyGuard(t *testing.T) {
	h := newHarness(t)
	editor := filepath.Join(h.home, "note-editor")
	if err := os.WriteFile(editor, []byte("#!/bin/sh\nprintf 'written interactively\\n' > \"$1\"\n"), 0o755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	out := h.mustRun("note", "add", "--repo", "demo", "--editor", "--editor-command", editor)
	if !strings.Contains(out, "written interactively") {
		t.Errorf("editor add: %q", out)
	}
	if _, _, err := h.run("note", "add", "--repo", "demo"); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "empty") {
		t.Errorf("empty add should fail, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestNoteListAllAndTagFilter(t *testing.T) {
	h := newHarness(t)
	h.mustRun("note", "add", "first", "--repo", "demo", "--tag", "one")
	h.mustRun("note", "add", "second", "--repo", "demo", "--tag", "two")
	out := h.mustRun("note", "list", "--all", "--tag", "two")
	if !strings.Contains(out, "second") || strings.Contains(out, "first") {
		t.Errorf("tag filter: %q", out)
	}
	out = h.mustRun("note", "list", "--all", "--json")
	var notes []map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(out), &notes); err != nil || len(notes) != 2 {
		t.Errorf("json notes=%v err=%v", notes, err)
	}
}

14	// listHeight budgets rows from what the current detail and footer actually
15	// render. REPOS has more detail and more key hints than TASKS; the old fixed
16	// chrome allowance let the complete view exceed terminal height, so Bubble
17	// Tea scrolled the first lines and the top tab bar appeared to disappear.
18	func (m Model) listHeight() int {
19		// Header + its blank line, table header, blank before detail, blank before
20		// footer. Detail and footer can each wrap/change by view and terminal width.
21		fixed := 2 + 1 + 1 + lineCount(m.renderDetail()) + 1 + lineCount(m.renderFooter())
22		h := m.height - fixed
23		if h < 3 {
24			return 3
25		}
26		// A long list adds the "… x–y of n" scroll note.
27		if m.count() > h && h > 3 {
28			h--
29		}
30		return h
31	}
32	
33	func lineCount(s string) int {
34		s = strings.TrimRight(s, "\n")
35		if s == "" {
36			return 0
37		}
38		return strings.Count(s, "\n") + 1
39	}
